reason: Keyset pages search every live enrolled candidate until canonical feature policy admits one. A refused candidate must not hide later eligible members, and an unbounded member load would violate the bounded-query contract.

The indexed completion-notice-pending source is cursor-drained in bounded pages; each notice commits independently under its live recipient admission and run locks. A refused or failed notice must not couple unrelated runs or hold locks across a whole backlog.

Definition repair and source-less scheduler cleanup each read bounded cursor pages and apply one ordered independent transaction per definition or cleanup page. Current grant/definition checks and unchanged orphan payload predicates must commit with their own scheduling writes; combining unrelated definitions would extend lock scope and couple failures.

Moves the existing organization index rebuild page and per-entity projection builder from pg-fts-provider unchanged, keeping maintenance outside request-only search admission. The old reader loses the same two directives; no new round trips or broader rebuild scope are introduced.
